newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya tea prices firm at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenya tea prices firm at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices were firm overall on Monday at the weekly auction, auction officials said.

Brighter BP1s gained up to five U.S. cents while the Brightest PF1s advanced by six cents. Other brighter types and mediums were three to five cents above last levels. Lighter liquoring types gained 7-10 cents following quality.
In secondary categories, Fannings and BMFs rose in value.
Pakistan was a very strong buyer, while Egypt and the Middle Eastern countries also continued to be active. There was more enquiry from Britain and South Africa.
